faculty.name: Alan DeSantis
faculty.summary: Studies college fraternity culture, nonprescribed stimulant use, and cigar smoking, including qualitative analyses of alcohol and persuasion in popular fraternity films.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大学兄弟会文化、非处方兴奋剂使用与雪茄吸食，并对兄弟会题材流行电影中的饮酒描绘与说服叙事进行质性分析。

faculty.name: Jess Dominguez
faculty.summary: Studies how people maintain friendships, family ties, and well-being through texting, group chats, memes, and chatbots, including queer friendships and loneliness.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过短信、家庭群聊、表情包和聊天机器人维系友谊与家庭关系及个人幸福感，包括酷儿友谊与孤独感。

faculty.name: Marko Dragojevic
faculty.summary: Studies language attitudes, accent bias, and linguistic stereotypes, examining how processing fluency and social categorization shape listeners' evaluations of speakers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言态度、口音偏见与语言刻板印象，探讨加工流畅性和社会分类如何影响听者对说话者的评价。

faculty.name: Allison Gordon
faculty.summary: Studies communication in medical decision making, from ICU family meetings and advance care planning to genetic risk disclosure and cancer survivorship, mainly through qualitative and mixed methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究医疗决策中的沟通，包括ICU家庭会议、预立医疗照护计划、遗传风险告知与癌症幸存者经历，主要采用质性与混合方法。

faculty.name: Rebecca Greer
faculty.summary: Studies organizational communication among foreign and migrant workers, including acculturation, stigma, upward dissent, defensive silence, and workplace gossip, with attention to Japan and the US.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究外籍与移民劳动者的组织传播，包括文化适应、污名、向上异议、防御性沉默与职场八卦，关注日本和美国情境。

faculty.name: Sitong Guo
faculty.summary: Studies sport communication and athlete social media self-presentation across Chinese and US contexts, comparing cultural values in fan and audience responses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究体育传播与运动员社交媒体自我呈现，比较中美情境下球迷与受众反应中的文化价值观差异。

faculty.name: Nancy Harrington
faculty.summary: Studies persuasive health message design and interventions, including sensation seeking, substance use prevention, and randomized trials of HIV/HCV screening messages in emergency departments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究说服性健康信息设计与干预，包括感觉寻求、物质滥用预防，以及在急诊科开展的HIV/HCV筛查信息随机对照试验。

faculty.name: Don Helme
faculty.summary: Studies and evaluates large-scale health communication campaigns on opioids, tobacco, and HPV vaccination, using formative focus groups and randomized message trials in Kentucky communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究并评估针对阿片类药物、烟草与HPV疫苗的大型健康传播运动，在肯塔基社区中采用形成性焦点小组与随机信息试验。

faculty.name: Hannah Jones
faculty.summary: Studies family communication under stress, such as bereavement, infertility, and political conflict, using longitudinal dyadic surveys to test relational turbulence and communal coping.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力情境下的家庭沟通，如丧亲、不孕与政治冲突，采用纵向二元调查检验关系动荡理论与共同应对。

faculty.name: Callie Kalny
faculty.summary: Holds a faculty post in the Department of Communication; the department profile gives no research description.
faculty.summary_zh: 任职于传播学系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

faculty.name: Derek Lane
faculty.summary: Studies instructional and risk communication, examining how hazard and weather warning messages shape risk perception and how students communicate in team-based and online learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究教学传播与风险传播，探讨灾害与天气预警信息如何影响风险感知，以及学生在团队学习和在线学习中的沟通。

faculty.name: Danni Liao
faculty.summary: Studies patient-provider communication and social support, especially international medical graduates' verbal and nonverbal strategies and migrants' coping, drawing on qualitative methods and scoping reviews.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究医患沟通与社会支持，尤其是国际医学毕业生的言语与非言语策略及移民群体的应对，运用质性方法与范围综述。

faculty.name: Anthony Limperos
faculty.summary: Studies the uses and effects of video games, exergames, and sports media, including audience responses to portrayals of athlete intimate partner violence, including experimental and content-analytic work.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究电子游戏、体感运动游戏与体育媒体的使用和效果，包括受众对运动员亲密伴侣暴力报道的反应，研究涉及实验与内容分析。

faculty.name: Chandler Marr
faculty.summary: Studies how organizational discourses shape employees' emotions, compassion, resilience, and dirty work, using interviews and ethnography to surface organizational contradictions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究组织话语如何塑造员工的情绪体验、同情、韧性与“肮脏工作”，借助访谈和民族志揭示组织中的矛盾与悖论。

faculty.name: Kelly McAninch
faculty.summary: Studies how people manage difficult conversations, including romantic partners discussing relationship problems and families and peers talking about health, coping, and social support.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何应对困难对话，包括恋人讨论关系问题，以及家人和同伴之间关于健康、应对与社会支持的交流。

faculty.name: Aurora Occa
faculty.summary: Designs and evaluates persuasive messages and interventions for complex or stigmatized health issues such as clinical trials, cancer screening, and mental health, across media and countries.
faculty.summary_zh: 设计并评估针对复杂或污名化健康议题（如临床试验、癌症筛查与心理健康）的说服性信息与干预，涉及多种媒介与国家。

faculty.name: Andrew Pilny
faculty.summary: Studies communication and interorganizational networks with social network analysis and machine learning, including AI coding of small group interaction and corporate control networks.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用社会网络分析与机器学习研究传播网络和组织间网络，包括用人工智能编码小群体互动以及企业控制网络。

faculty.name: Kevin Real
faculty.summary: Studies communication in healthcare organizations, linking hospital built environments, care teams, and patient safety through observation, behavior mapping, and focus groups.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究医疗组织中的沟通，通过观察、行为映射与焦点小组，将医院建成环境、医护团队与患者安全联系起来。

faculty.name: Jennifer Scarduzio
faculty.summary: Studies the dark side of interpersonal, health, and organizational communication, including workplace and online sexual harassment, burnout, and intimate partner violence, through qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人际、健康与组织传播的阴暗面，包括职场与网络性骚扰、职业倦怠和亲密伴侣暴力，主要采用质性方法。

faculty.name: Amber Lynn Scott
faculty.summary: Studies team communication in high reliability organizations and the military, including grief and embodied trauma after organizational failure, using qualitative and content analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高可靠性组织与军队中的团队沟通，包括组织失败后的哀伤与具身创伤，采用质性研究与内容分析。

faculty.name: Qingru Xu
faculty.summary: Studies athlete and influencer self-branding and social media self-presentation, comparing Chinese and US sport audiences and examining how branding cues shape trust and authenticity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动员与网红的自我品牌塑造及社交媒体自我呈现，比较中美体育受众，并探讨品牌线索如何影响信任与真实性感知。

faculty.name: Xun Zhu
faculty.summary: Studies intergroup prejudice, stereotypes, and identity in health and narrative messages, plus deception and neighborhood storytelling networks, using experiments, network analysis, and meta-analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康与叙事信息中的群际偏见、刻板印象与身份认同，以及欺骗信息和社区叙事网络，采用实验、网络分析与元分析。

faculty.name: Deborah Chung
faculty.summary: Studies online and citizen journalism and journalists' role conceptions, along with how brands' humanlike social media presence drives consumer engagement, in US and South Korean contexts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究网络新闻与公民新闻及记者角色认知，并研究品牌在社交媒体上的拟人化呈现如何驱动消费者参与，涉及美国与韩国情境。

faculty.name: Erika Engstrom
faculty.summary: Studies television and film through critical textual analysis of religion, gender, and sexuality, from Catholic horror and Mad Men to queer comedy.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过批判性文本分析研究电视与电影中的宗教、性别与性向议题，涵盖天主教恐怖剧、《广告狂人》与酷儿喜剧。

faculty.name: Carey Higgins-Dobney
faculty.summary: Studies labor, technology, ownership, and burnout in US local television newsrooms, including unionization and the working conditions of digital journalists.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究美国地方电视新闻编辑室中的劳动、技术、所有权与职业倦怠，包括工会化及数字记者的工作条件。

faculty.name: Kyra Hunting
faculty.summary: Studies television, children's media, and fandom, analyzing gender representation and industrial intertextuality in franchises such as Disney, Barbie, and My Little Pony.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究电视、儿童媒介与粉丝文化，分析迪士尼、芭比、小马宝莉等媒介系列中的性别再现与产业互文性。

faculty.name: Yung Soo Kim
faculty.summary: Studies photojournalism and visual journalism, examining ethical dilemmas, professional versus citizen roles, and framing through content analysis of news images and television.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新闻摄影与视觉新闻，通过对新闻图片和电视的内容分析考察伦理困境、职业与公民记者角色以及框架。

faculty.name: Kathryn Montalbano
faculty.summary: Studies how US communication law and policy have shaped speech, press, assembly, and religious expression since the nineteenth century, using historical research on media law and surveillance.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究十九世纪以来美国传播法律与政策如何塑造言论、新闻、集会与宗教表达，以历史方法研究媒介法与监控。

faculty.name: Beecher Reuning
faculty.summary: Holds a faculty post in the School of Journalism and Media; the department profile gives no research description.
faculty.summary_zh: 任职于新闻与媒体学院；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

faculty.name: Jennifer Smith
faculty.summary: Studies media law and public records, analyzing tensions between open records laws, privacy, and college athletes' name, image, and likeness agreements.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介法与公共记录，分析公开记录法、隐私权与大学运动员姓名、形象和肖像权协议之间的张力。

faculty.name: David Stephenson
faculty.summary: Holds a faculty post in the School of Journalism and Media; the department profile gives no research description.
faculty.summary_zh: 任职于新闻与媒体学院；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

faculty.name: Zixue Tai
faculty.summary: Studies digital media use and mental health among Chinese students, including problematic smartphone use, gaming, and pandemic coping, mainly through surveys and mixed methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中国学生的数字媒介使用与心理健康，包括问题性智能手机使用、游戏和疫情期间的应对，主要采用调查与混合方法。

faculty.name: Kakie Urch
faculty.summary: Studies cultural studies, modernism, typography, and rhetorical delivery, using critical and textual analysis of popular and literary texts such as self-help books.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化研究、现代主义、字体排印与修辞表达，以批判与文本分析方法解读自助书等通俗及文学文本。

faculty.name: Alyvia Walters
faculty.summary: Holds a faculty post in the School of Journalism and Media; the department profile gives no research description.
faculty.summary_zh: 任职于新闻与媒体学院；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

faculty.name: Alyssa Eckman
faculty.summary: Studies the boundary between journalism and advertising, using ethnographic case studies of organizational conflict over advertorials in news organizations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新闻与广告之间的边界，以民族志个案研究考察新闻机构中围绕“软文广告”产生的组织冲突。

faculty.name: Sarah Geegan
faculty.summary: Holds a faculty post in integrated strategic communication; the department profile gives no research description.
faculty.summary_zh: 任职于整合战略传播系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

faculty.name: Adriane Grumbein
faculty.summary: Studies advertising creativity, visual communication, and advertising careers and diversity, including content analysis of graphic and design elements.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究广告创意、视觉传播以及广告职业发展与多元化，包括对图形与设计元素的内容分析。

faculty.name: Erin Hester
faculty.summary: Studies public interest communication and social marketing, designing campaigns on health and risk issues such as lung cancer screening and opioid abatement with community partners and focus groups.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公共利益传播与社会营销，与社区伙伴合作并借助焦点小组，为肺癌筛查、阿片类药物治理等健康与风险议题设计传播活动。

faculty.name: Hyun Ju Jeong
faculty.summary: Studies corporate social responsibility, cause-related marketing, and green advertising, testing through experiments how messages drive consumers' and Gen Z's pro-environmental behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任、善因营销与绿色广告，通过实验检验信息如何推动消费者及Z世代的亲环境行为。

faculty.name: Mengtian “Montina” Jiang
faculty.summary: Studies how consumers process branded content in digital spaces, including influencer marketing, native advertising, live-streaming commerce, and AI influencers, using mixed methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究消费者如何处理数字空间中的品牌内容，包括网红营销、原生广告、直播电商与AI网红，采用混合方法。

faculty.name: Hanyoung Kim
faculty.summary: Holds a faculty post in integrated strategic communication; the department profile gives no research description.
faculty.summary_zh: 任职于整合战略传播系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

faculty.name: Jihye Kim
faculty.summary: Studies cause-related marketing, CSR, and digital consumer engagement, including virtual influencers, ChatGPT adoption, and Korean media-driven tourism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究善因营销、企业社会责任与数字消费者参与，包括虚拟网红、ChatGPT采纳及韩国媒介驱动的旅游。

faculty.name: Leigh Moscowitz
faculty.summary: Studies media framing of LGBTQ+ issues, especially gay and trans athletes, and lifestyle advertorials, using framing and discourse analysis of US news and digital media.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒体对LGBTQ+议题（尤其是同性恋和跨性别运动员）及生活方式软文的框架呈现，对美国新闻与数字媒体开展框架与话语分析。

faculty.name: Kimberly Parker
faculty.summary: Studies health and social marketing campaigns and inoculation messaging, testing message length and modality in experiments on vaccine uptake and college students' mental health.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康与社会营销运动及免疫（预防接种）信息，通过实验检验信息长度与模态对疫苗接种和大学生心理健康的影响。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Spencer
faculty.summary: Studies visual communication, digital media, and health contexts, especially media messages about people living with dementia and their caregivers, plus medical tourism websites.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉传播、数字媒体与健康情境，尤其是关于失智症患者及其照护者的媒介信息，以及医疗旅游网站。

faculty.name: Weilu Zhang
faculty.summary: Studies AI and human influencers, chatbots, and brand engagement on social media, using deep learning text analysis of platform data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究AI与真人网红、聊天机器人以及社交媒体上的品牌互动，采用基于深度学习的平台文本分析。
